title: postrestrictionsaddwithvalidpayload
description: Verify that POST /restrictions/add with a valid app restriction payload returns 200 Success and the newly added restriction appears in GET /restrictions/list.

title: deleterestrictionsremovewithvalididentifier
description: Verify that DELETE /restrictions/remove with a valid restricted app identifier returns 200 Success and the removed restriction no longer appears in GET /restrictions/list.

title: postrestrictionsaddwithinvalidpayload
description: Verify that POST /restrictions/add with an invalid or incomplete restriction payload returns a non-200 error and GET /restrictions/list remains unchanged.

title: getrestrictionslistwithnoactiverestrictions
description: Verify that GET /restrictions/list returns 200 with an empty list when no active restrictions are configured and no overlay lock screen is triggered during app foreground monitoring.

title: postrestrictionsaddwithmalformeddailylimit
description: Verify that POST /restrictions/add with a malformed daily limit value returns a non-200 error and no enforcement overlay lock screen is shown during app foreground monitoring.

title: postquotesaddwithvalidpayload
description: Verify that POST /quotes/add with a valid custom quote payload returns 200 with the saved Quote and the quote appears in the app's quote list or display area.

title: deletequotesdeletewithvalididentifier
description: Verify that DELETE /quotes/delete with a valid quote identifier returns 200 Success and the deleted quote no longer appears in the saved quotes list.

title: postquotesaddwithinvalidpayload
description: Verify that POST /quotes/add with an empty or invalid quote payload returns a non-200 error and the quote is not saved or present in the saved quotes list.
